# qbitOS KBatch — llms.txt

> https://github.com/qbitOS/qbitos-kbatch

## Summary

KBatch (L4) — world keyboard analyzer: **121 capsules**, **16 categories**, **15 layouts**, StenoEngine, contrail, IBM Quantum bridge, plan corpus cross-links. Runs on Gluelam + Iron Line.

## Key files

- docs/KBATCH_ARCHITECTURE.md — full placement + channels
- docs/kbatch-overview.md — short pointer
- reference/kbatch-surface.json — JSON surface summary
- COMPLIANCE.qmd — org baseline
